name: Lemon Ricotta Pasta
description: Bright, creamy pasta for the nights when dinner should be easy.
steps: Cook the spaghetti until just tender, reserving a cup of pasta water.
Stir together ricotta, lemon zest, parmesan, and pepper.
Toss the pasta with the ricotta mixture, loosening with pasta water until creamy.
Finish with lemon juice and extra parmesan.

name: Crispy Smashed Potatoes
description: Golden edges, fluffy centers, and enough garlic to make the kitchen smell right.
steps: Boil the potatoes until fork-tender, then drain and cool briefly.
Place them on a baking sheet and gently smash each one.
Drizzle with oil, then season with garlic, rosemary, and salt.
Roast until the edges are deeply golden and crisp.

name: Roasted Berry Oats
description: A make-ahead breakfast with jammy berries and a toasted oat topping.
steps: Heat the oven and add the berries to a small baking dish.
Stir the oats, milk, maple syrup, and cinnamon together.
Spoon the oat mixture over the berries.
Bake until the topping is golden and the berries are bubbling.
